name: SRAM
verdict: SRAM is a private company owned by the Day family and its management team (co-founder Stan Day, Pinkbike, Jan 2019). Nothing found.
note: Chicago-based component manufacturer; co-title sponsor of Canyon//SRAM (Cyclist, 2026-07-14). Rating note: owned by the Day family and management (claim sram-day-family-ownership); no state capital found; no relevant human-rights record found. Trade-press coverage of Peter Bengtsen's Taiwan bicycle-industry investigations names SRAM only as one of the companies that adopted no-fee recruitment policies in late 2025 (Bengtsen 'Speeding Up', May 2026), not as a finding against SRAM.
